# LNEC controlled-cost housing study, 2024

[Regime de habitação de custos controlados: Limites de área e de custo
definidos na Portaria n.º 65/2019](https://repositorio.lnec.pt/handle/123456789/1018255)
is a 2024 paper by João Branco Pedro in the proceedings of the 5.º Congresso
Internacional da Habitação no Espaço Lusófono (CIHEL). The LNEC repository
lists an issue date of **2 October 2024**.

The research project `social-security-housing-investment` pins the author-
provided conference paper PDF:

- Research filename: `lnec_ci47_2024.pdf`.
- SHA-256 in `data/sources/housing_cost_sources.json`:
  `2a87f4eff0f30d4d23322ce4c8c2c71bcb64cb4ff25f2175484a2eab02e3be1d`.
- Size: 1,069,964 bytes; retrieved on 30 October 2026.

The paper discusses the controlled-cost housing formula and coefficients,
including a **May 2024 worked example of €944.36/m²**. It is a normative
regulatory **ceiling/example**, not an observed average tender price or a
2026 total construction cost. It should not be mixed with actual Portal BASE
contract costs without reconciling the price bases and cost components.

**Copyright:** the [LNEC repository record](https://repositorio.lnec.pt/handle/123456789/1018255)
states that the file was provided by an author and rights are reserved to the
authors and publisher. Access to the PDF does not authorize mirroring it.
This record is for attribution and provenance only; no source bytes or
